q: The Hahn decomposition theorem states that for a signed measure ν on (X,Σ), X can be decomposed as X = P ∪ N with P ∩ N = ∅ where:
opts: P and N are both positive sets
P is a positive set (ν(A) ≥ 0 for all A ⊆ P) and N is a negative set (ν(A) ≤ 0 for all A ⊆ N)
P and N are disjoint open sets
exp: Hahn decomposition: every signed measure admits a partition into a positive set P and negative set N. The Jordan decomposition ν = ν⁺ − ν⁻ then gives ν⁺(A) = ν(A∩P) and ν⁻(A) = −ν(A∩N).
